messages.content: What is the best month to visit Hawaii?

function.name: get_average_monthly_temperature
function.description: Retrieve the average monthly temperature of a location. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The location that you want to get the average monthly temperature for.

month.description: Month for which the average temperature needs to be fetched.

But we might want to use the function to get average monthly temperature for Hawaii for each month. But the question is about best month to visit Hawaii, not just temperature. We can provide a recommendation: May or September are good because mild temperatures, fewer crowds, good for beaches and hiking. Or we can mention that June-July are peak tourist season with higher prices. So best months are April, May, September, October. Provide average temperatures for those months. Use function calls for each month. Let's call get_average_monthly_temperature for "Hawaii" for "April", "May", "September", "October". Then we can provide the data.
